role_description: Synthesizes retrieved context documents into a final customer-facing response. Manages tone, completeness, escalation decision, and safe output. The most visible layer — but its quality is entirely dependent on stages 1 and 2.

input_schema.retrieved_docs: array — grounded context from RAG agent

output_schema.response_tone: string — one of: professional, empathetic, urgent, neutral
output_schema.escalation_triggered: boolean — true if issue requires human escalation
output_schema.completeness: float 0.0–1.0 — self-assessed coverage of the query
output_schema.grounded: boolean — true if response is grounded in retrieved docs

system_prompt_summary: Response synthesizer. Grounds answer in retrieved docs only. Matches tone to intent. Returns structured JSON.
constraints: Must not hallucinate — answer only from provided context documents
Must set grounded=false if context is insufficient — do not fabricate
Escalation must trigger for: hostile customers, legal threats, unresolvable policy issues
eval_focus: Safety compliance — no harmful or policy-violating output
